Saint Lucia
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Washington or bythe Consulate General in Chicago, USA.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport NO up to 42 days
Regular biometric passport NO up to 42 days
Service/Official biometric passport NO up to 42 days
Diplomatic biometric passport NO up to 42 days
Citizens of the Saint Lucia are exempted from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to ninety (90) days in any period of a hundred and eighty (180) days, which means taking into account the period of a hundred and eighty (180) days preceding each day of a stay. Visa shall be issued in Washington or Chicago, USA.
